description: This file defines a Java interface 'IdentifiableStreamingMessage' that extends another interface 'StreamingMessage', representing a streaming message with a required identifier for correlation purposes.

classes.name: IdentifiableStreamingMessage
classes.description: An interface specifying a streaming message with an identifiable string, used for correlating acknowledgements.

methods.name: asIdentifierString
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this streaming message as a string.
